JAINA_UI_AEGWYNN_DEATHRATTLE: [gold]Deathrattle[/gold]: Gain +{Bonus} Strength. When this dies, pass this effect to the next minion card you draw.
JAINA_UI_MINION_SELECT_PAGE_DESC: Change the minion selection hotkeys (default: small-keypad 1-7 select your minions, Esc cancels). Click a key row to record a new key; Clear resets to default; Reset to default in the menu restores everything. Changes apply immediately.
JAINA_UI_MINION_SELECT_SECTION_DESC: Small-keypad 1-7 select / deselect your 1st-7th minion (gold frame + card preview); the companion key cancels the current selection.
